book.title: Aposel Yon bung xailongdi mala rangua riang hatuminga haringinamdi. Tauxu xailong mugamugangamga li ba, 1 Yon

content: Tahatum Haringina Mana Urana Garanoa
Lipu gaxarea dahatum haringina ba Yesu bing Urana Lipuxing Mogunganama, ding Urana garandi. Baing lipu gaxarea muruding sibuna mana garadi tibuding bing muruding sibuna mana garandi xauna.
Bila balau, daxanga taxabia ba murura sibuna mana Urana garandi bing: Murura sibuna mana Urana saing tasu mana hanaunaungandi.
Daxanga murura sibuna mana Urana bing: Tasu mana hanaunaungandi. Baing hanaunaungandi dimakasa makira te.
Namua na lipu gaxarea Urana garandi, didali titia li kubolunoa. Baing daxanga mana tadali titia li kubolunoa bing hatumingara haringina.
Gaxarea dali titia li? Lipuadi dahatum haringina ba Yesu Urana Garanoa ding ganiding.

Lipua ma titia xap langa saing sibinoa ri bing Yesu Kristo baing. Xap langa ing ganina te, ne xap langa xaung sibinoa ri. Baing Urana Aningonoa baxanga haruanga ba, saing Aningonoa namua mana haruanga maxunama.
Axamang tuwa tung dibaxanga:
Aningonoa, langa xaung siba. Tung hatumingading taininau.
Kira tahatum haringina mana lipudi haruangadinga mana baraxing baraxinta dibagu maxadingia. Ne Urana haruanganoa sabanga sibuna manadi, namua na ma rangua Urana. Baing harua mana Garanoa.

Lipu gaxarea hatum haringina mana Urana Garanoa, tuxu haruanga ba maluxuʼm hatuminganoa. Lipu gaxarea hatum haringina te uxu Urana ba lipu languangama, namua na hatum haringina mana haruangua Urana harua mana Garanoa te.
Baing haruanga ba bing: Urana sina walinga subingang teguama nakira, saing walinga ba namua bing Garanoa.
Lipu gaxarea taga rangua Urana Garanoa xap walingua. Lipu gaxarea taga rangua Urana Garanoa te, xap walingua te.
Haruanga Kimuam
Ngabung axadi li nang gaxarea ahatum haringina mana Urana Garanoa bu axabia ba axap walinga subingang teguama.
Baing hatumingaradi daharing bungina tala haxek rangua Urana, namua na taxabia ba nabu taxusunga mana axamandi disu mana murunganoa, bing lungu kira.
Baing nabu taxabia ba lungu kira mana baraxing baraxinta taxusunga mana, bing taxabia ba taxap baraxinta taxusunga mana.

Nabu lipu tela bagu riang hatuminga haringinama libu kubolu diana xai mala mana daxanga matiama te, bing sabu mana, saing Urana bagula sina walingua na rianoa ba. Ngaharua mana adi kuboluding diandi daxaidi mala mana daxanga matiama te. Ne kubolu dian teladi daxai lipudi mala mana daxanga matiama. Ngaharua ba sabu mana axadi bagudi ba te. Tegu.
Kubolu maringing teguam longgalo kubolu diandi, ne kubolu dian teladi daxai lipudi mana daxanga matiama te.
Taxabia ba lipu baruamta sok Urana garanoa libu kubolu diandi muli te. Ne Urana Garanoa wasa mana, bu lipu dianoa sanga ba hanggalangia te.
Taxabia ba kira Urana garandi, saing titi hataing longgalo duwa hawa mana lipu diana rimanoa.

Baing taxabia xauna ba Urana Garanoa ma bu sina hatuminga xaiyua nakira, bu taxabia ba Urana lipu maxunama. Baing tataga rangua lipu maxunama, namua na tataga rangua Garanoa Yesu Kristo. Ing sibuna Urana maxunama xaung namua mana walinga subingang teguama.
Garagu mana, amaxania xai bu awa hasoya mana urana languangamdi.
